snippet.title: Revenge On Gold Diggers is Now Available on Consoles
snippet.description:
Can you tell the difference between true love and a carefully planned deception?

Discover **Revenge On Gold Diggers (情感反诈模拟器)**, a Chinese live-action interactive psychological drama about romance, betrayal, and revenge.

Play as Wu Yulun, a man who has suffered betrayal and sets out to expose a dangerous romance scam operation.

💔 Discover the hidden dangers behind deceptive relationships.
🔍 Investigate suspicious behavior and uncover secrets.
🎬 Experience a cinematic live-action thriller.
🧠 Navigate psychological manipulation and difficult decisions.
🎮 Make choices that influence the unfolding story.

Would YOU recognize the red flags before it's too late?

**PLAY ON CONSOLES**

🎮 PlayStation:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016344/

🎮 Xbox:
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/revenge-on-gold-diggers/9pjtn600v9rm

🎮 Nintendo Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Revenge-On-Gold-Diggers-3064390.html
